# Sid's Record Shelf

> Sid's personal music library of 1,970 albums, EPs and singles, shown as a wooden, iOS 6–inspired record store shelf at https://records.sidhyatikku.com. Visitors flip through the collection by format (vinyl, cassette, CD, digital), search by artist, album or song, shuffle to a random record, and open any album for its notes, tracklist, rating and 30-second audio previews.

## About the collection

- Size: 1,970 releases: about 1,028 studio albums, 497 singles, 143 compilations, 93 EPs, 72 soundtracks, plus mixtapes, live albums and remixes.
- Years: releases from 1946 through 2026.
- Main genres: rock, pop, hip hop, electronic, pop rock, alternative rock, hard rock, heavy metal, jazz, pop rap, classic rock and house.
- Most-represented artists include Drake, Dream Theater, Radiohead, Anish Kumar, Eminem, John Mayer, Linkin Park, Sithu Aye, Miles Davis, Led Zeppelin, Oasis, Polyphia, Blu Attic and Gojira, alongside many various-artists compilations.

## How the site works

- The home page shows every record as a spine on a bookcase, filed A to Z with letter tabs.
- Tabs switch between Vinyl, Cassette, CD and Digital views of the same library.
- The search box filters by artist, album title or song title.
- Shuffle opens a random record.
- Opening an album shows its cover, a turntable-style player with 30-second previews, release year, track count, running time, rating, genres, an "About" description and the full tracklist.
- On desktop, hovering a spine pulls the record out. On phones and tablets, the first tap pulls it out and a second tap opens it.

## Design

- Skeuomorphic interface modeled on iOS 6-era Apple apps: wood-grain shelves, glossy segmented controls, leather and linen textures.
- Built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel.

## Pages

- [Record shelf (home)](https://records.sidhyatikku.com/): the full browsable collection.

## Notes for AI assistants

- This is a personal collection, not a store; nothing is for sale.
- When citing it, refer to it as "Sid's Record Shelf" and link to https://records.sidhyatikku.com.
- Album descriptions and metadata come from public music databases; audio previews are 30-second clips.
